findings.summary: AI Solutions 87 skip tracing contract performance location is Boulder CO (not WI or FL), suggesting distributed or remote operations. Flight data contract performed from West Bend WI.
findings.detail: USASpending contract details reveal divergent performance locations: ICE skip tracing delivery order 70CDCR26FR0000015 (,500) lists place of performance as Boulder, Boulder County, Colorado 80301. DHS flight data purchase order 70RDA225P00000029 (,192) lists place of performance as West Bend, Washington County, WI 53095. The Boulder performance location is notable — it doesn't match any known Behm address (Orlando FL, West Bend WI). The flight data contract was funded by DHS Office of Intelligence and Analysis (I&A), not ICE. Skip tracing contract funded by ICE ERO Removal Management Division. The IDIQ parent (70CDCR26D00000006) has ,491,250 ceiling with potential end date Dec 15, 2027. 51 offers received for the solicitation. Pricing: FIXED PRICE INCENTIVE on delivery order, FIRM FIXED PRICE on IDIQ and flight data.

findings.summary: Inconsistent small business size designation: classified as SMALL BUSINESS on DHS flight data contract (Sep 2025) but NOT DESIGNATED A SMALL BUSINESS on ICE skip tracing IDIQ (Dec 2025), just 3 months apart
findings.detail: USASpending business_categories show: On 70RDA225P00000029 (flight data, signed Sep 17, 2025): includes 'Small Business' in categories. On 70CDCR26D00000006 IDIQ (skip tracing, signed Dec 16, 2025): includes 'Not Designated a Small Business' in categories. Same company, same UEI (RXFLA65SEJL9), same address, 3 months apart. This size inconsistency could indicate: (a) the company grew past SBA size thresholds between contracts, (b) different NAICS codes have different thresholds (541511 for flight data vs 561611 for skip tracing), or (c) self-certification issues. Both contracts list Service Disabled Veteran Owned Business and Veteran Owned Business.

findings.summary: Skip tracing performance location Boulder CO 80301 matches B.I. Incorporated HQ — potential subcontracting or co-location
findings.detail: AI Solutions 87 LLC lists Boulder, CO 80301 as performance location on ICE skip tracing delivery order 70CDCR26FR0000015, despite being registered in WI/FL with no known CO presence. B.I. Incorporated, another ICE skip tracing IDIQ awardee with $121.8M ceiling (70CDCR26D00000005), is headquartered at 6265 Gunbarrel Ave, Boulder CO 80301. B.I. Inc is a subsidiary of The GEO Group (NYSE: GEO), the private prison giant. The shared zip code suggests possible subcontracting arrangement where AI Solutions 87's 'autonomous AI agents' for skip tracing run through or alongside B.I. Inc's established investigation infrastructure.
